plan: Rebuilt after attempt 1 lost 6-3. Two lessons from attempt 1, both mechanical. (1) Shiftry's Wind Rider ABSORBS Heat Wave - Heat Wave is a wind move, so my opening spread attack did zero damage and handed Shiftry a free +1 Attack. Attempt 2 attacks Shiftry with Air Slash and Play Rough, neither of which is a wind move. (2) Sheer Force Life Orb Earth Power from Nidoking is 2x into both Magnezone and Excadrill and OHKOed each of them before they acted; this party leads with two Ground-immune or Ground-neutral bodies instead. Charizard (Flying) is outright immune to Earth Power, Azumarill resists Icicle Spear and is 2x into both Shiftry (Fairy) and Nidoking (Water), Alakazam's Psychic is 2x into both Poison types, and Magnezone is held in reserve purely as the 2x Electric answer to Cloyster once Nidoking is gone.
